title: Otomi - Wikipedia
text: The Otomi are an Indigenous people of Mexico inhabiting the central Mexican Plateau region.Otomi languages are part of the Otomanguean language family, one of the oldest and most diverse in the Mesoamerican area.

title: Otomí, Estado de México Language... | Ethnologue Free
text: Estado de México Otomí is a stable indigenous language of Mexico. It belongs to the Otomanguean language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is not known to be taught in schools.
